text.en:
The provincial, municipal, and city governments are hereby authorized, subject to the approval
of the Department Head, to appropriate funds for the purchase of real or personal property to be donated to the
National Government for the use of the Philippine Army.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, October 12, 1936.
